body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Canon announced its new lineup of standard definition camcorders for a complete consumer recording experience at CES 2008.
The FS11 dual flash memory camcorder offers a 16GB internal Flash drive, for up to 10 hours of video recording, plus adds the flexibility of an SDHC memory card slot.
The FS10 dual flash memory camcorder offers an 8GB internal flash drive, for up to five hours of recording capacity, and also features an SDHC card slot.
The FS100 flash memory camcorder has an SDHC card slot only, and comes in three stylish colors – silver, navy blue and wine red.
All three camcorders share Genuine Canon 48x Advanced Zoom along with a 1.07 Megapixel CCD Image Sensor, and Canon’s DIGIC DV II Image Processor for exceptional color and clarity.

An Intelligent Lithium-ion Battery displays the remaining recording time to the minute, and a microphone terminal provides added audio flexibility. Weighing only 9.2 ounces, these ultra-sleek camcorders are just as stunning as the images they capture.
The FS11, FS10 dual flash memory and FS100 flash memory camcorders are scheduled to be available in April, at the estimated retail prices of $599, $499 and $399, respectively.
